<p align="center"><strong>Star lantern assembled. Find the northern path upstairs.</strong></p>

<p align="center"><small><strong>Inventory:</strong> Brass key &middot; Moonseed &middot; Copper coil &middot; Star lantern</small></p>


<p align="center">A thin white star appears in the lantern. At the window, a dozen borrowed faces peel away into darkness. Mother Hollow has nothing beneath them.</p>

<p align="center">She withdraws into the trees. The seed and coil remain secured inside the lantern you carry. For now, its light reaches farther than her hands.</p>

<p align="center">A narrow stair climbs to the observatory. The beacon must face the path that leads out of her October night.</p>
